name: Visit brass craft workshops in Pembarthi
description: The Incredible India page says visitors can walk into local workshops and watch artisans shape brass into idols, figurines and utensils.
availability_note: Incredible India states visitors can walk into local workshops and watch brass shaping. The page does not guarantee opening days, fees, booking or a named host.

name: Watch Dhimsa Dance in the Araku region
description: The district cultural-tourism page describes Dhimsa as a major tribal dance form in Araku and Paderu and reports regular weekend performances at local tourism hotspots. Confirm the current venue and performance schedule before making a booking promise.
months_or_season: Weekend performances are reported; confirm locally.
availability_note: The district portal reports weekend performances; venue, dates and host are not guaranteed for a particular travel date.

name: Taste Bamboo Chicken near Chaparai / Araku
description: The district tourism portal describes Bamboo Chicken as a local speciality prepared by marinating chicken and cooking it inside bamboo stalks over an open fire. It notes local vendors in the Chaparai area; individual vendor operations must be confirmed.
availability_note: No verified vendor name, opening hours or booking process in the source.

name: Araku Tribal Museum and Coffee Museum visit
description: The district tourism page describes the Tribal Museum and Coffee Museum as visitor attractions covering tribal material culture and the history/cultivation/processing of Araku coffee. Confirm current operating hours and entry fees.
months_or_season: Year-round subject to opening hours; verify before visiting.
availability_note: Use official on-site notices for opening times, ticket price and photography rules.
unverified_fields: current hours;ticket fee;holiday closures;guided tour booking

name: Explore Pedana Kalamkari block-printing process
description: Krishna district ODOP describes the Pedana Kalamkari block-printing stages, including wooden-block printing, vegetable dyes, drying, washing and mordanting. This supports a learning/demo concept, but no public visitor booking or open workshop schedule is confirmed.
availability_note: Contact an authorised producer/cooperative and obtain permission before offering workshop bookings.

name: Observe Durgi stone-carving stages
description: Palnadu district ODOP describes Durgi stone-carving materials and stages such as stone selection, marking and preparing a clay model. A visitor demonstration is a proposed experience and must be confirmed with a local artisan or cooperative.
availability_note: Do not advertise as bookable until a host confirms timing, safety and price.

name: Meet Bobbili Veena artisans in Gollapalli
description: Vizianagaram district tourism identifies Gollapalli near Bobbili as the Veena-making village and describes the wood and time involved in making an instrument. Public workshop access and visitor permissions are not specified.
availability_note: Contact the district handlooms/textiles office or a consenting artisan before planning a visit.

name: Learn about Ponduru Khadi production
description: Srikakulam district identifies Ponduru as a village known for fine khadi production. A spinning/weaving demonstration could be a strong cultural experience, but a visitor programme is not confirmed in the source.
availability_note: Confirm access with the local khadi institution or district handlooms office.

name: Learn Pochampally Ikat weaving
description: Telangana Tourism describes Pochampally as a place where visitors can learn about Ikat weaving and visit heritage sites. Confirm the specific weaving centre, demonstration times and whether participation is offered on the chosen date.
availability_status: tourism page describes learning experience;host/timing unconfirmed
availability_note: Contact a local weaver/cooperative before promising a live demonstration.

name: Explore Nirmal toy and painting traditions
description: Telangana Tourism and the state culture portal describe Nirmal toys, paintings and local folk forms. Use this as a craft discovery page; a live workshop or artist meeting should only be listed after confirmation.
availability_note: No workshop schedule or booking is provided in the cited sources.

name: Watch or learn Perini Shivatandavam
description: Telangana Tourism identifies Perini Sivatandavam as an ancient dance form of Telangana that has been revived. The source does not provide a permanent visitor performance schedule; list performances only when a dated event is verified. The experience is linked to Warangal as a regional cultural cluster; verify current performance venue and schedule before publication.
months_or_season: Event-specific; no fixed calendar in cited source.
availability_note: Requires a current event listing, venue and organiser confirmation.

name: Explore Adilabad Dokra craft locations
description: Telangana government identifies Dokra/bell-metal craft in Jainoor mandal, Ushegaon and Chittalbori and describes traditional figurines and motifs. Visitor access must be arranged with local artisans or relevant community organisations.
availability_note: Obtain community consent and local host confirmation; do not publish private artisan contact details without permission.

name: Visit Warangal durrie weaving cluster
description: Telangana Tourism describes Warangal as a centre for cotton durries woven by local artisans. The existence of the craft is documented; a specific public workshop or visitor programme still needs confirmation. The experience is linked to Warangal as a regional craft cluster; verify the specific weaving unit and visitor access.
availability_note: Find and confirm a participating cooperative or artisan before creating a booking listing.
